videos.title: The gaming business after GTA VI | The Vergecast
videos.description:
Grand Theft Auto VI is out today, and it’s basically a foregone conclusion that it’s going to be an enormous hit. (It’s also just a spectacularly great game.) But what does this one title mean for the rest of the gaming industry? Game File’s Stephen Totilo explains how GTA became so important to the gaming business, why GTA Online might be an even bigger deal, and why we might never see another game quite like this one.

videos.title: GTA VI is the love story of our times | The Vergecast
videos.description:
It took 13 years, a reported 10-figure budget, and the weight of the world’s expectations, but Grand Theft Auto VI is here. And it’s fantastic. The Verge’s Andrew Webster takes a break from the game to tell us all about life in Vice City, and why GTA VI’s approach to coffee tells us everything we need to know.
